12/06/2005: Station Maintenance: (sm) 
 
            - Another battery failure at the Elk Rapids MAWN station led to 
              a loss of data during the following time period: 
 
                 12/02/2005 (Day=336) 06:00   -   12/06/2005 (Day=340) 14:15 
 
            - Battery was replaced today and power to cell phone modem converted 
              back to switched power (powered on between 06:00 - 06:15 am/pm). 
 
 
 
11/21/2005: Station Maintenance: (sm) 
 
            - Recent battery failure at the Elk Rapids MAWN station led to  
              a loss of data during the following time period: 
               
                 11/08/2005 (Day=305) 00:55   -   11/21/2005 (Day=325) 17:20 
 
            - Battery was replaced today and the Elk Rapids station is 
              back online. 
 
 
 
09/24/2005: Station Maintenance (sm): 
 
            - Telecomminications Change - Reconfigured to Cell Phone System: 
              - Replaced COMM 100 Modem with Airlink Alltel Redwing 
                CDMA Cell phone/modem system. 
              - Installed SC932B Interface 
              - Installed 11dB game Yagi antenna with antenna lightning 
                protection decive. 
              - Wired "C3" Control Port to "+12V Control" terminals. 
              - Connected Cell System Power to "+12 VDC Switched" Port  
                on datalogged 
 
              - Loaded New Data Logger Program:   MAWN1D 
                - This version of MAWN1D powers cell system between  
                    6:00am - 6:10am daily. 
 
              - Sensors/Battery Checked and Telecommunications Tested. 
 
 
 
06/01/2005  Station Maintenance (sm): 
 
            - General Station Maintenance and System Checks: 
              - weed removal and application of Round-Up above soil temps 
              - cleaned Air Temp/Relative Humidty sensor 
              - check Anemometer/Wind Vane 
              - cleaned Precipitation bucket 
 
 
 
=========================================================================== 
 
12/03/2004: Telecommunication Troubles Corrected (sm): 
 
            - Recent loss of communication led to a site-visit.  It was 
              discovered that the telephone lines inside the datalogger 
              enclsure were damaged and needed to be repaired.   Repairs 
              were made and communincation with datalogger has been 
              reestablished. 
 
 
05/04/2004: Telecommunication Troubles - Continue: 
 
            - Recent telecommunication troubles continue to occur 
              at the Elk Rapids MAWN station.  Due to the serious 
              nature of the trouble, the station has needed to be 
              taken offline until further notice. 
 
 
 
04/28/2004: Telecommunication Maintenance (crn): 
 
            - Possible faulty modem replaced 
            - Reloaded Datalogger Program: MAWN1B 
            - Outage from 04/16/2004 caused a loss of data 
              from 04/16/2004 (16:00) - 04/27/2004 (13:00) 
 
 
 
04/16/2004: Telecommunication Trouble: 
 
            - We are currently experiencing communication 
              trouble with the Elk Rapids MAWN station.  The 
              phone line has been disconnected until the  
              trouble with the modem is corrected (jtb). 
 
 
 
04/06/2004: Data Logger Maintenance (jtb): 
 
            - Datalogger error (E08) codes were reading 99.   
              Counters were reset back to 00.  This action  
              will hopefully resolve and/or prevent brief  
              data outages observed on some data loggers  
              when the error count reaches 99.

            - Datalogger clock was somehow reset after 04:15 on Nov 19 (Day=323). 
 
            - Clock was corrected at 13:10 on Nov 20 (Day=324).  Data records  
              while clock was incorrect are not available.
